frozen_candidate_root_contribution: A pleasant, benefit-bearing condition of well-being/ease - being in it, being put into it, or the good thing that constitutes it: the positive well-being pole opposed to harm/adversity (Darra'/shar/kufr), prototypically bestowed (default giver = Allah) and calling for grateful acknowledgment. It is realized relationally as a conferred favor (niEmah / >anEama), experientially as enjoyed bliss or worldly ease (naEiym / naEmah / naAEimah / naE~ama), and grammaticalized as a laudative evaluation 'how excellent / how good is X' (jamid niEma). This nucleus governs the derivational family (~107 occ.); it does NOT extend to the lexicalized concrete count-noun >anEam/naEam 'grazing livestock' (~33 occ.), whose link to 'benefit' is carried by neighbouring words, is undemonstrated Quran-internally, and is even inverted in pejorative similes.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: A pleasant, benefit-bearing condition of well-being/ease - being in it, being put into it, or the good thing that constitutes it: the positive well-being pole opposed to harm/adversity (Darra'/shar/kufr), prototypically bestowed (default giver = Allah) and calling for grateful acknowledgment. It is realized relationally as a conferred favor (niEmah / >anEama), experientially as enjoyed bliss or worldly ease (naEiym / naEmah / naAEimah / naE~ama), and grammaticalized as a laudative evaluation 'how excellent / how good is X' (jamid niEma). This nucleus governs the derivational family (~107 occ.); it does NOT extend to the lexicalized concrete count-noun >anEam/naEam 'grazing livestock' (~33 occ.), whose link to 'benefit' is carried by neighbouring words, is undemonstrated Quran-internally, and is even inverted in pejorative similes.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across most of its occurrences the root n-E-m names good, pleasant well-being: a favor granted (niEmah), the act of granting it (>anEama), the enjoyed bliss of the Garden (naEiym), worldly ease/soft-living (naEmah, naE~ama, naAEimah), and a frozen verb of praise ('excellent is...'). All of these hang together as one field of 'agreeable good, bestowed / enjoyed / declared,' the opposite of harm and ingratitude. But the same consonants also spell a completely concrete word, >anEam 'grazing livestock/cattle,' which the Qur'an uses as an ordinary animal term and even as an image of sub-rational heedlessness ('like cattle, nay more astray'). That livestock sense is not the well-being nucleus applied; it is a separate lexicalized noun. So the honest result is one coherent nucleus over a derivational family plus one unbridged concrete class - not a single unified meaning over all 140 tokens.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: n-E-m (nucleus) does NOT entail: (1) moral rectitude/rightness - that is Hsn/SlH/Tyb; its 'good' is the pleasant/beneficial/comfortable dimension, not moral quality (only the grammaticalized laudative broadens to generic 'excellent'); (2) the recipient's virtue or gratitude - favors are denied and changed (14:28:6:1, 16:83:2:1), luxury is held by deniers (73:11:4:2, 44:27:1:2), shukr is a separate, explicitly paired response; (3) permanence - permanence is added lexically (muqiym 9:21:9:1) while naEmah is enjoyed then lost (44:27:1:2); (4) raw wealth/quantity - it spans material ease and non-material goods (prophethood 19:58, guidance 1:7:3:1); (5) 'cattle' - >anEam/naEam is a lexicalized natural-kind noun (listed separately from dawabb at 35:28:4:3) whose bridge to the nucleus is thematic and even inverted, not lexical.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 7:179:24:3 'kal->anEam bal hum >aDall' (identically 25:44:11:3; reinforced by 47:12:19:2 'ya'kuluwna kama ta'kulu l->anEam' and Satanic ear-slitting of >anEam at 4:119:6:2). Here the identical consonantal root, which elsewhere names the bliss the righteous are questioned about and the Gardens of naEiym, surfaces as a bare concrete count-noun deployed to DEGRADE humans as sub-rational beasts - the semantic antipode of the well-being nucleus. No verse derives the animal sense from the good-state sense, so their unity would be asserted, not shown; this single datum blocks any STRONG/unified reading and caps the result at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single root-wide nucleus 'GOOD / BENEFIT' that folds cattle in, since >anEam are repeatedly framed as God-given provision (khalaqaha lakum, manafiE, rizq, mataE: 16:5:1:3, 16:66:4:2, 16:80:11:2, 40:79:5:2, 79:33:3:3, 80:32:3:3), making kal->anEam a live metaphor exploiting that a benefit-animal is non-rational. Rejected: (a) this is thematic co-occurrence, not lexical identity - the Qur'an also calls rain, ships, spouses and the night 'favors' without their nouns being n-E-m-derived; being counted among God's favors does not make a noun a semantic output of n-E-m; (b) the word's own selected feature surfaces in the pejorative uses (7:179:24:3, 25:44:11:3, 47:12:19:2) as 'non-rational beast'; (c) >anEam is listed as a class distinct from dawabb (35:28:4:3); (d) the bridge is imported from outside the packet's lexical evidence, exactly what the source policy forbids as authority. A second competitor - 'divine favor/grace' as the whole-root core - fails for the laudative (evaluates servants, guardians, abodes, not grace: 38:30:4:1, 3:173:16:2), for the worldly naEmah of the doomed (73:11:4:2, 44:27:1:2), and for livestock.

A second competitor - 'divine favor/grace' as the whole-root core - fails for the laudative (evaluates servants, guardians, abodes, not grace: 38:30:4:1, 3:173:16:2), for the worldly naEmah of the doomed (73:11:4:2, 44:27:1:2), and for livestock.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converged: (i) a coherent narrow nucleus over the abstract derivational family (favor niEmah, verb >anEama, bliss naEiym, ease naEmah/naE~ama/naAEimah, laudative jamid niEma), internally bridged by cognate-accusative constructions (8:53:7:1 niEmah + 8:53:8:1 >anEama; 27:19:10:1 + 27:19:12:1) and by shared antonymy with the harm-pole (11:10:3:1 naEma' baEda Darra'; 17:83/41:51 shar); (ii) one genuinely resistant, synchronically lexicalized concrete class >anEam/naEam 'grazing livestock' (~24% of tokens) not Quran-internally bridged to the nucleus and even inverted in pejorative similes. Per the contract, a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE and bars STRONG. The result is not UNRESOLVED because the claim is NOT forced across the unbridged senses: it is scoped to the derivational family and the livestock class is explicitly recorded as a separate resistant lexicalized class. The internal vocalic sense-split (kasra niEmah 'favor' vs fatHa naEmah 'ease' vs faEiyl naEiym 'bliss') is itself a Quran-internal demonstration that same consonants != one meaning, and the broken plural >anEum (16:112:15:2, 16:121:2:2) shows the favor-nucleus even has its own plural distinct from livestock >anEam.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: niEmah / plural >anEum / niEam = a conferred good/favor: countable-or-collective good that is granted, default giver Allah, recipient marked by EalaY; response-terms are shukr/dhikr, opposable by kufr/inkar/tabdil.
clusters.classification_rationale: Diagnostic collocations fix the sense: remembered (2:40:4:1-type udhkuru niEmatiy), completed/perfected (yutimmu niEmatahu 48:2), uncountable (la tuHSuha 14:34/16:18), recognized-then-denied (16:83:2:1), exchanged for kufr (14:28:6:1). The broken plural >anEum (16:112:15:2 kafarat bi->anEumi llah, 16:121:2:2 shakiran li->anEumihi) and sound plural niEam (31:20:15:1) carry the SAME favor sense, confirming this is the favor-node, not livestock.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Bridged to the verb by cognate accusative (8:53:7:1 niEmah + 8:53:8:1 >anEama; 27:19:10:1 niEmatak + 27:19:12:1 >anEamta) - the noun is the thing the verb bestows.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: >anEama (Form IV) = to confer a good upon / place someone in a good state, rigid frame '>anEama EalaY + recipient'; subject overwhelmingly Allah; content unspecified (prophethood 19:58, guidance 1:7:3:1, rescue 5:23:6:1).
clusters.classification_rationale: Uniform transitive causative construction governing EalaY; the bestowed good = C1 niEmah (cognate-accusative bridge). Opposed to shar/Durr (17:83:2:1, 41:51:2:1). Rare human co-subject (33:37) still 'place in good state'.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 1:7:3:1 alladhiyna >anEamta Ealayhim; 4:69:8:1 >anEama llahu Ealayhim mina n-nabiyyin.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: jamid niEma / niEimma (frozen fiEl al-madH) = 'how excellent / how good is X!' - a grammaticalized positive evaluation, structural counterpart of bi'sa; predicates on servants, God's roles, abodes and rewards; it neither confers nor denotes a benefit.
clusters.classification_rationale: Non-inflecting praise verb with a following makhSuS bi-l-madH: niEma l-Eabd (38:30:4:1), niEma l-wakiyl (3:173:16:2), niEma l-mawlaY wa niEma n-naSiyr (8:40), niEma >ajru l-Eamiliyn (39:74); fused niEimma (2:271:4:2, 4:58:18:1). Overlaps the nucleus only in the thin abstraction 'good', so it is a distinct evaluation-node within the family, not the favor/bliss sense.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Its Quranic antonym is bi'sa, marking a pure praise/blame evaluative pair.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: >anEam / (base) naEam = grazing livestock/cattle: a concrete lexicalized natural-kind count-noun. NOT the well-being nucleus applied; its valence ('benefit') is supplied entirely by neighbouring words (khalaqaha lakum, manafiE, rizq, mataE), never by the word itself.

clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Etymologically motivated as benefit-yielding animals but synchronically lexicalized; the live positive/pleasant/favor sense is absent, and the pejorative similes make a unified reading self-contradictory.

reconciliation.rationale: Context (kafarat bi->anEumi llah) and parallelism with kufr-of-niEmah verses fix it as FAVORS; only vocalization+context, not the broken-plural shape, sorts the two nuclei. Stays in C1.
Denotes sacrificial cattle (hunting-penalty equivalent), a concrete livestock referent; belongs with the lexicalized C6 class, not the ease-nucleus.

adversarial_verification.notes: The well-being nucleus over the derivational family (C1-C5, ~107 occ.) was adversarially probed (Lens C) and held with distinctive, non-vacuous predictions and internal bridges; no in-scope occurrence falsifies it. occurrence_dispositions.verse_text: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ

occurrence_dispositions.note: tilka niEmah tamunnuha EalayY (Pharaoh) - a boundary, not a counterexample: it confirms niEmah = 'benefaction that would oblige gratitude', the rhetoric being that Pharaoh miscategorizes oppression as such.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: niEmah / plural >anEum / niEam = a conferred good/favor: countable-or-collective good that is granted, default giver Allah, recipient marked by EalaY; response-terms are shukr/dhikr, opposable by kufr/inkar/tabdil.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Bridged to the verb by cognate accusative (8:53:7:1 niEmah + 8:53:8:1 >anEama; 27:19:10:1 niEmatak + 27:19:12:1 >anEamta) - the noun is the thing the verb bestows.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: Diagnostic collocations fix the sense: remembered (2:40:4:1-type udhkuru niEmatiy), completed/perfected (yutimmu niEmatahu 48:2), uncountable (la tuHSuha 14:34/16:18), recognized-then-denied (16:83:2:1), exchanged for kufr (14:28:6:1). No Quran-internal derivation links >anEam to the niEmah nucleus; the bridge is thematic, undemonstrated, and even inverted. Resistant at root level.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: >anEam / (base) naEam = grazing livestock/cattle: a concrete lexicalized natural-kind count-noun. NOT the well-being nucleus applied; its valence ('benefit') is supplied entirely by neighbouring words (khalaqaha lakum, manafiE, rizq, mataE), never by the word itself.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Etymologically motivated as benefit-yielding animals but synchronically lexicalized; the live positive/pleasant/favor sense is absent, and the pejorative similes make a unified reading self-contradictory.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) converged on the same nucleus, the same C1-C6 fault-lines, the same cognate-accusative bridges (8:53, 27:19), and the same strongest counterexample (7:179 / 25:44 / 47:12).
candidate_root_contribution: A pleasant, benefit-bearing condition of well-being/ease - being in it, being put into it, or the good thing that constitutes it: the positive well-being pole opposed to harm/adversity (Darra'/shar/kufr), prototypically bestowed (default giver = Allah) and calling for grateful acknowledgment. It is realized relationally as a conferred favor (niEmah / >anEama), experientially as enjoyed bliss or worldly ease (naEiym / naEmah / naAEimah / naE~ama), and grammaticalized as a laudative evaluation 'how excellent / how good is X' (jamid niEma). This nucleus governs the derivational family (~107 occ.); it does NOT extend to the lexicalized concrete count-noun >anEam/naEam 'grazing livestock' (~33 occ.), whose link to 'benefit' is carried by neighbouring words, is undemonstrated Quran-internally, and is even inverted in pejorative similes.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Built bottom-up from all 140 packet occurrences via vocalized surface form (qac_surface_form_buckwalter) + syntactic frame, since the QAC N/V/V(II)/V(IV) buckets collapse distinct lexemes; counts verified to partition (50+17+17+5+18+33=140).
layer_attribution.derivation: The nucleus is a derivational family related by internal morphology and cognate-accusative constructions: niEmah (favor) <-> >anEama (bestow) via 8:53 and 27:19; naEiym (bliss) / naEmah / naE~ama / naAEimah (ease) as the enjoyed-state pole; jamid niEma as grammaticalized evaluation.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: >anEam/naEam 'grazing livestock' is a synchronically lexicalized concrete natural-kind noun (distinct from dawabb, 35:28:4:3); the broken plural >anEum is the favor-nucleus's own plural, distinct in reference from livestock >anEam.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Livestock is thematically ASSOCIATED with benefit (created-for-you, manafiE, rizq) but that association is contextual/narrative and imported by neighbouring words; it must NOT be promoted into the root claim, exactly as rain/ships/spouses are called favors without being n-E-m-derived.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Boundary shapes were resolved by vocalization+context, not morphology: >anEum (16:112, 16:121) -> favor (C1); naEam (5:95) -> livestock (C6); Pharaoh's niEmah (26:22) -> a contested-but-genuine favor category (C1).
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The livestock class (C6, ~24% of tokens) persists as unbridged to the nucleus and is even inverted in pejorative similes (7:179:24:3, 25:44:11:3, 47:12:19:2); this resistance is why scope is REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY and strength is capped at MODERATE.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The entire >anEam/naEam livestock class (~33 occ., ~24%) persists as resistant to the well-being nucleus: it is a synchronically lexicalized concrete count-noun, unbridged Quran-internally and even inverted in pejorative similes. It is therefore recorded as a multi-class resistance rather than forced into one nucleus; all 33 are RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases and appear in counterevidence_refs.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal construction that makes the livestock class the nucleus applied rather than a lexicalized concrete noun - e.g. >anEam/naEam itself predicated as niEmah by the word, or governed as the conferred good in an '>anEama EalaY' frame, or a derivational pun explicitly linking >anEam to niEmah/naEiym; equivalently, showing the vocalic sense-split (kasra niEmah favor / fatHa naEmah ease / faEiyl naEiym bliss) collapses so the family is a single undifferentiated 'good'.
rejection_condition.search_location: All C6 livestock occurrences (esp. 16:5:1:3, 16:66:4:2, 40:79:5:2, 6:138) and the boundary shapes >anEum 16:112:15:2/16:121:2:2 and naEam 5:95:18:2; cross-checked against C1 niEmah and C2 >anEama frames.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether the benefit predicate attaches to >anEam by the word itself vs by neighbouring lexemes (khalaqaha lakum, manafiE, rizq); test whether any >anEama/niEmah construction takes cattle as its cognate good; test whether pejorative similes (7:179, 25:44, 47:12) can be read with a live positive-benefit sense without contradiction.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude thematic co-occurrence (livestock merely LISTED among favors) as evidence of lexical identity - apply the same test that excludes rain/ships/spouses (non-n-E-m nouns also called favors); require the bridge from packet lexical evidence, not imported lexica/tafsir.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the bridge is demonstrated, C6 merges into the nucleus and the claim upgrades toward STRONG/ROOT_GENERALIZATION; if instead the family nucleus itself fractures (vocalic split shown non-semantic or laudative shown to entail conferral), the claim narrows or drops to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY.

reopen_conditions: If any occurrence shows >anEam/naEam (livestock, C6) itself governed by >anEama 'EalaY' or predicated as niEmah/naEiym by the word rather than by neighbouring lexemes (test 16:5:1:3, 16:66:4:2, 40:79:5:2), bridging C6 to the nucleus.
If the fatHa naEmah/naEma' ease-class (11:10:3:1, 44:27:1:2, 73:11:4:2) is shown to collapse into kasra niEmah 'favor', dissolving the vocalic sense-split that keeps C4 distinct from C1.
If the jamid laudative niEma (38:30:4:1, 3:173:16:2, 2:271:4:2) is shown to entail conferral/benefit rather than bare 'excellent'-evaluation, merging C5 into the favor node.
If the broken plural >anEum (16:112:15:2, 16:121:2:2) is shown to denote cattle rather than favors, reopening the C1/C6 boundary.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The well-being nucleus over the derivational family (C1-C5, ~107 occ.) was adversarially probed (Lens C) and held with distinctive, non-vacuous predictions and internal bridges; no in-scope occurrence falsifies it. A full PASSED is withheld because a coherent resistant lexicalized sub-class (C6 livestock) remains outside the nucleus by design of the claim; per contract this is NOT_RUN with recorded resistance, not FAILED (the core was not refuted) and not PASSED (an unbridged class persists).
